The '''Di'tai'ni Diplomatic Landing Circle''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Di'tai'ni]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was based there for a time, during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]].
